sections.heading: Sankrail: Howrah's Food Park Cluster
paragraphs: Most of Howrah's new food-processing capacity is going into WBIDC's food parks at Sankrail, about 28 km from Kolkata on the six-lane NH-6. Sudha Ras, the first phase, covers 49.98 acres and houses food processors, cold-chain operators and packaging-material makers, including a Frito Lay unit of PepsiCo India. It adjoins Kandua (Kendua) Food Park, the second phase, a third food park phase and WBIDC's Poly Park. The Kolkata Dock Complex is about 36 km away, and the port town of Haldia is also within reach. For a buyer of hygienic tube, Sankrail is the part of Howrah district where new dairy and food plants are being built.

sections.heading: Amul's Sankrail Dairy: Curd at a New Scale
paragraphs: GCMMF, which sells under the Amul brand, said in February 2025 that it would invest Rs 600 crore in two phases in an integrated dairy at Sankrail Food Park, built by Kaira District Co-operative Milk Producers' Union of Anand. Its managing director said the plant would process 15 lakh litres of milk a day and include a curd plant of 10 lakh kg a day, which GCMMF described as the world's largest. Amul already sells more than 10 lakh litres of milk a day in Bengal.

The project has grown since 2017, when Amul first named Kendua Food Park for a Rs 250 crore plant of about 10 lakh litres a day. The curd focus reflects Bengal's demand for set curd, tok doi and mishti doi.

sections.heading: Curd and Mishti Doi Lines: Grade and Finish
paragraphs: Fermented-product lines are where hygienic tube matters most in a dairy. Milk is standardised, heat-treated, cooled to incubation temperature and dosed with culture, then filled into cups or pots and set. Everything after the culture dosing point carries live product, and a stray yeast or mould from a pitted weld or a dead leg shows up as off-flavour or a short shelf life weeks later.

We suggest 316L on culture dosing, inoculated-milk transfer and filler manifolds, because lactic acid and hot acid-and-caustic CIP cycles are harder on 304L. Electropolished SF4 tube is worth its cost on those post-inoculation lines; raw-milk reception and chilling can run in SF1 mechanically polished 304L. Joints should be orbital welds with a smooth bead, or clamp ferrules with gaskets suited to the cleaning chemistry.

sections.heading: What to Send With a Howrah Enquiry
bullets: Which lines carry inoculated product and which carry raw or heat-treated milk.
CIP chemistry and temperatures, so the grade suits the cleaning regime.
OD x wall in ASTM A270 or ASME BPE dimensions, and metres per size.
Fitting types: bends, tees, reducers and clamp ferrules matched to the tube.

Documents you need: a measured Ra report for each electropolished lot, PMI on every length and an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to the heat number. We quote within 24 hours and confirm delivery time in the quotation.

sections.heading: Delivery to Howrah and Sankrail
paragraphs: Orders for Howrah leave Mumbai by road, and we state the dispatch date and transit in writing when we confirm each one; electropolished tube is capped and sleeved for the journey.
